notes_for_editor: Built year 1938 agrees across the register and Forest Lookouts. The record's county (Sumter) is the current location; the register gives the original site as Marlboro County, so the record is not wrong but both counties are relevant. Sale date is 'late 1990s' (register) and 199?? (Forest Lookouts), so no event year was assigned for the move. Condition after the 2013 registration is unknown. The owner is a private individual; the story does not name them. Height 100 ft (30.5 m) is the tower height; the register's 248 ft (76 m) is ground elevation.
